verdict.rationale: Lambda is a cloud platform with public docs, so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question. A probe returned HTTP 404 for docs.lambda.ai/llms.txt, and no evidence shows any LLM-focused or agent-targeted documentation. A machine-readable OpenAPI spec exists at cloud.lambda.ai, but that is an API description, not agent-oriented docs, and the only MCP tooling is an unofficial community project.
